segments: A route-heavy upgrade with a fixed painting story order, a ghost-wolf escort, and one anti-gravity wall shot.
Four story paintings around the castle
Activate the paintings in story order
Interact with the four paintings in this order: King on throne with wolves → King on horseback holding a flag → mountain castle struck by lightning → slain king with his servant mourning him.
The wall / crypt in the Undercroft opens after the painting sequence. Collect the broken Wolf arrow inside.
At the Rocket Test site, shoot the red flag high on the mountain to make the wolf skull fall.
Place the skull on the wolf skeleton near the Pyramid. Follow the ghost wolf when it begins moving.
At each dig location, kill zombies to feed the wolf’s soul meter, then interact with the completed site to collect the bones before following it onward.
At the final Undercroft stop, activate anti-gravity, wall-run, and shoot the glowing wolf symbol while airborne.
A platform appears. Reach it and interact with the skeleton to receive the reforged Wolf arrow.
Place the arrow into the Wolf altar, feed zombie souls, insert the base bow, and take the upgraded Wolf Bow.
The painting positions can vary; the story order does not.
Keep the last zombie controlled before the anti-gravity wall shot.
